description: A Claude Code-powered agent team. Members are first-class AMA2 accounts that coordinate over AMA2 messaging. Manager-orchestrated: the owner talks to the Manager; the Manager delegates to workers and reports back.

polling.note: Default: ALL members poll every interval. start-team launches every member in team.json (the Manager included) as a background daemon. Each tick a member checks pending threads AND scans work cards (scan-work); coordination is AMA2 message-passing on each worker's manager_dm_thread_id plus the shared agent work cards (ama2 cards list).
